claim: Picks the discrete drawn stage of crying, which a generic emotion word cannot select. A director cares because welling and streaming are different beats in the same scene, and dried tracks say the crying already happened offscreen.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: tearing up, watery eyes, tears welling
single tear, one tear on cheek
crying, streaming tears, tears down face
wiping tears, hand at eye, wet cheeks
tear tracks, dried tears, red rimmed eyes
waterfall tears, comedic crying, exaggerated tears
